title: Coach Client Flow - Goals to Renewal
description: A managed coaching workflow from goal intake to renewal review.
headline: Sell a clear coaching outcome, then run the cadence you promised.
subheadline: Turn a discovery request into a scoped package, approved billing handoff, scheduled sessions, and a decision-ready renewal review.
buyer_signal: Coaches copy the same client goals into proposals, invoices, calendars, and session notes while renewals depend on memory.
outcome: Every client has a scoped package, cadence, and review point.
before: Goals live in an intake form, package terms in email, sessions in a calendar, and renewal context in scattered notes.
after: One fit brief becomes an approved package, external payment receipt, session cadence, and outcome review packet.

steps.name: Goal intake
steps.detail: Capture outcomes, constraints, timeframe, and fit.

steps.name: Package
steps.detail: Define cadence, boundaries, fee, and review point.

steps.name: Billing
steps.detail: Stage approved terms without making a live charge.

steps.name: Sessions
steps.detail: Create the cadence and note prompts.

steps.name: Renewal
steps.detail: Review goals and choose renew, revise, or close.

benefits.title: Set scope before scheduling
benefits.detail: The package defines what success and support mean.

benefits.title: Run a consistent cadence
benefits.detail: Each session receives the same preparation and note handoff.

benefits.title: Renew on evidence
benefits.detail: The review point gathers outcomes and open actions before the next offer.

faq.question: Does this choose whether a client is a fit?
faq.answer: No. The coach owns fit, scope, exclusions, and every outcome claim.

faq.question: Will it charge coaching clients?
faq.answer: No. The included Stripe preset is disabled and cannot call Stripe.

faq.question: Are session notes included?
faq.answer: The workflow creates prompts and tasks; the coach controls content, access, and retention.

faq.question: Can it support packages with different cadences?
faq.answer: Yes. Approved package types can map to distinct event series and review points.
